title: Hawass 1992 speech on subterranean labyrinths under the plateau

tellings.quote:
he was uh giving a speech at a
university in Cairo where he was like
there are subterranean labyrinths
underneath the plateau.

plain: In 1992, at a university in Cairo, the Egyptian archaeologist Zahi Hawass gave a speech saying there are underground labyrinths beneath the Giza plateau, according to a guest named Jay Anderson. Anderson tells Michels this without naming a source, and it would mean Egypt's own top archaeologist once spoke openly about hidden tunnels under the pyramids.
